Title: Anion-exchange membrane electrolysis water membrane electrode assembly and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and discloses an anion exchange membrane electrolysis water membrane electrode assembly and a preparation method thereof. The anion exchange membrane electrolysis water membrane electrode assembly comprises an anion exchange membrane, an anode gas diffusion electrode and a cathode gas diffusion electrode, the anode gas diffusion electrode comprises an anode catalyst layer and an anode gas diffusion layer, and the cathode gas diffusion electrode comprises a cathode catalyst layer and a cathode gas diffusion layer; the anode catalyst layer comprises a first anode catalyst layer and a second anode catalyst layer, the first anode catalyst layer and the second anode catalyst layer are sequentially attached to the surface of the anode diffusion layer from inside to outside, and the aperture of the first anode catalyst layer is larger than that of the second anode catalyst layer. By arranging the first anode catalyst layer and the second anode catalyst layer, an anode catalyst layer structure with gradient pore size distribution is formed, and meanwhile, the activity and the stability of the anion exchange membrane electrolysis water membrane electrode assembly are improved.

Title: Membrane electrode for producing hydrogen by electrolyzing water and electrolytic bath
Abstract: The invention provides a water electrolysis hydrogen production membrane electrode and an electrolytic bath, and belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, the water electrolysis hydrogen production membrane electrode comprises an anion exchange membrane, a cathode catalyst layer and an anode catalyst layer, the cathode catalyst layer is arranged on one side of the anion exchange membrane, and the cathode catalyst layer comprises a first cathode catalyst and a second cathode catalyst; the anode catalyst layer is arranged on the side, away from the cathode catalyst layer, of the anion exchange membrane, and the anode catalyst layer comprises a first anode catalyst and a second anode catalyst. Wherein the first cathode catalyst, the second cathode catalyst, the first anode catalyst and the second anode catalyst are all non-noble metal catalysts, the first cathode catalyst is different from the second cathode catalyst, and the first anode catalyst is different from the second anode catalyst. The water electrolysis hydrogen production membrane electrode provided by the embodiment of the invention can ensure good catalytic activity and stability while reducing the cost.
Applicants: HUIZHOU EVE HYDROGEN ENERGY CO LTD

Title: Membrane electrode for producing hydrogen by electrolyzing water, preparation method of membrane electrode and electrolytic bath
Abstract: The invention provides a water electrolysis hydrogen production membrane electrode, a preparation method thereof and an electrolytic bath, and belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, the water electrolysis hydrogen production membrane electrode comprises a composite anode layer, an anion exchange membrane and a composite cathode layer, and the composite anode layer comprises an anode substrate layer, a first gas diffusion layer and an anode catalyst layer. The anion exchange membrane is arranged on the side, provided with the anode catalyst layer, of the composite anode layer, the composite cathode layer is arranged on the side, away from the composite anode layer, of the anion exchange membrane, and the composite cathode layer comprises a cathode substrate layer, a second gas diffusion layer and a cathode catalyst layer. According to the water electrolysis hydrogen production membrane electrode provided by the embodiment of the invention, interface resistance among at least part of components can be eliminated, so that ion transmission and gas diffusion are smoother, and the electrolysis efficiency is improved.
Applicants: HUIZHOU EVE HYDROGEN ENERGY CO LTD

Title: Membrane electrode for AEM water electrolysis hydrogen production
Abstract: The utility model discloses a membrane electrode for AEM water electrolysis hydrogen production, which comprises an anion exchange membrane, an anode catalyst layer and a cathode catalyst layer are respectively arranged on two opposite side surfaces of the anion exchange membrane, an anode protective layer is arranged on one side of the anode catalyst layer far away from the anion exchange membrane, and a cathode protective layer is arranged on the other side of the cathode catalyst layer far away from the anion exchange membrane. A cathode protection layer is arranged on one side, far away from the anion exchange membrane, of the cathode catalyst layer; the anode protection layer, the anode catalyst layer, the anion exchange membrane, the cathode catalyst layer and the cathode protection layer are sequentially connected into an integral structure; and the peripheral sizes of the anode protection layer and the cathode protection layer are greater than those of the anion exchange membrane, the anode catalyst layer and the cathode catalyst layer. The membrane electrode has the characteristics of low impedance and high catalytic activity, and can obviously improve the water electrolysis hydrogen production efficiency when being used in an AEM electrolytic cell.
Applicants: HUIZHOU EVE HYDROGEN ENERGY CO LTD

Title: Water electrolysis membrane electrode, preparation method thereof and electrolytic bath
Abstract: The invention provides a water electrolysis membrane electrode, a preparation method thereof and an electrolytic bath. The water electrolysis membrane electrode comprises an anode porous transmission layer, an anode catalyst layer, an anion exchange membrane, a cathode catalyst layer and a cathode porous transmission layer which are sequentially stacked; the cathode catalyst layer comprises a third sub-catalyst layer and a fourth sub-catalyst layer which are stacked, and the third sub-catalyst layer is located on the side, facing the anion exchange membrane, of the fourth sub-catalyst layer; wherein the contact angle of the first sub-catalyst layer is larger than that of the second sub-catalyst layer, and the contact angle of the third sub-catalyst layer is smaller than that of the fourth sub-catalyst layer. Layered structures are respectively arranged in the anode catalyst layer and the cathode catalyst layer, so that a directional gas-liquid transmission channel pointing to the anode porous transmission layer and the cathode porous transmission layer can be constructed in the water electrolysis membrane electrode, rapid transmission of reactants and products can be ensured, concentration polarization under large current is greatly inhibited, and the water electrolysis membrane electrode has the advantages of simple structure, low cost and the like. Therefore, the ideal performance of the water electrolysis membrane electrode is ensured when the water electrolysis membrane electrode operates under high current density.
Applicants: HUIZHOU EVE HYDROGEN ENERGY CO LTD

Title: Membrane electrode assembly and method for producing hydrogen by electrolysis
Abstract: The present invention discloses a membrane electrode assembly and a method for producing hydrogen by electrolysis. The membrane electrode assembly comprises: an anode comprising a first catalyst layeron a first gas-liquid diffusion layer; a cathode including a second catalyst layer on a second gas-liquid diffusion layer; and an anion exchange membrane clamped between the first catalyst layer of the anode and the second catalyst layer of the cathode, wherein the chemical structure of the first catalyst layer is M'aM''bN2 or M'cM''dCe, M' is Ni, Co, Fe, Mn, Cr, V, Ti, Cu, or Zn; M'' is Nb, Ta,or a combination thereof, 0.7 =a<=1.7, 0.3<=b<=1.3, a+b=2, 0.24<=c<=1.7, 0.3<=d<=1.76, 0.38<=e<=3.61, M'aM''bN2 is a cubic system, and M'cM''dCe is a cubic system or an amorphous system.

Title: Membrane electrode assembly and method for hydrogen evolution by electrolysis
Abstract: The present invention discloses a membrane electrode assembly and a method for hydrogen evolution by electrolysis, the method for hydrogen evolution by electrolysis comprises: immersing the membrane electrode assembly in an alkaline aqueous solution, the membrane electrode assembly comprising: an anode comprising a first catalyst layer on a first gas-liquid diffusion layer; a cathode including a second catalyst layer on the second gas-liquid diffusion layer; and an anion exchange membrane interposed between the first catalyst layer of the anode and the second catalyst layer of the cathode, wherein the chemical structure of the first catalyst layer, the second catalyst layer, or both is MxRuyN2, M is Ni, Co, Fe, Mn, Cr, V, Ti, Cu, or Zn, x is greater than 0 and less than 1.3, y is greater than 0.7 and less than 2, x + y is equal to 2, and MxRuyN2 is a cubic system or an amorphous system; and applying a potential to the anode and the cathode to electrolyze the alkaline aqueous solution,so as to enable the cathode to generate hydrogen and the anode to generate oxygen.

Title: Membrane electrode for AEM water electrolysis hydrogen production and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a membrane electrode for AEM water electrolysis hydrogen production and a preparation method thereof.The membrane electrode for AEM water electrolysis hydrogen production comprises an anion exchange membrane, an anode catalyst layer and a cathode catalyst layer are arranged on the two opposite side faces of the anion exchange membrane respectively, an anode protection layer is arranged on the side, away from the anion exchange membrane, of the anode catalyst layer, and a cathode protection layer is arranged on the side, away from the anion exchange membrane, of the cathode catalyst layer; a cathode protection layer is arranged on one side, far away from the anion exchange membrane, of the cathode catalyst layer; and the anode protection layer, the anode catalyst layer, the anion exchange membrane, the cathode catalyst layer and the cathode protection layer are sequentially connected to form an integral structure. The membrane electrode has the characteristics of low impedance and high catalytic activity, and can obviously improve the efficiency of hydrogen production by electrolyzing water when being used in an AEM electrolytic cell, and the preparation method has the advantages of simple steps and easily available raw materials, and can be used for large-scale industrial production.
Applicants: HUIZHOU EVE HYDROGEN ENERGY CO LTD

Title: High-stability membrane electrode and preparation method thereof, and water electrolyser applying high-stability membrane electrode
Abstract: The invention provides a high-stability membrane electrode, a preparation method of the high-stability membrane electrode and a water electrolyser applying the high-stability membrane electrode. The high-stability membrane electrode comprises an anode gas diffusion layer, an anode catalyst layer, an anion exchange membrane, a cathode catalyst layer and a cathode gas diffusion layer which are sequentially stacked, wherein the anode catalyst layer is prepared by the following steps: S1, mixing a nickel ferrite catalyst, polytetrafluoroethylene, an anion exchange membrane ionomer and a solvent, and uniformly stirring to prepare nickel ferrite catalyst slurry; and S2, coating the anode gas diffusion layer with the nickel ferrite catalyst slurry, performing drying to obtain a membrane electrode intermediate, placing the membrane electrode intermediate in inert gas, and performing heat preservation at the heat preservation temperature of 300-500 DEG C for 5-60 minutes to obtain an anode catalyst layer. The membrane electrode provided by the invention is good in structural stability and excellent in water electrolysis catalytic performance, a water electrolysis bath applying the membrane electrode can keep long-time operation, and the hydrogen production efficiency is high.
Applicants: HUIZHOU EVE HYDROGEN ENERGY CO LTD

Title: Membrane electrode assembly of anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell and preparation method of membrane electrode assembly
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, in particular to a membrane electrode assembly of an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell and a preparation method of the membrane electrode assembly. Comprising the following steps: step 1, adding modified titanium dioxide, an epoxy group cross-linking agent and a modified polymer into toluene, and homogenizing; casting by using a phase inversion method, and carrying out cross-linking treatment at 75-85 DEG C for 6-8 hours to obtain an anion exchange membrane; step 2, respectively spraying cathode catalyst slurry and anode catalyst slurry on two sides of the anion exchange membrane, drying and curing to form a cathode catalyst layer and an anode catalyst layer; a cathode protection layer is attached to the surface of the cathode catalyst layer through vacuum adsorption, an anode protection layer is attached to the surface of the anode catalyst layer through vacuum adsorption, and rolling is conducted; therefore, the membrane electrode assembly of the anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell is obtained.
Applicants: BEIJING YINENG HYDROGEN SOURCE TECH CO LTD

Title: Branched polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of new materials, and discloses a branched polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The invention provides a branched polyaryl piperidine polymer with high conductivity and alkali stability and an anion exchange membrane. The anion exchange membrane takes p-terphenyl as a main structure of a polymer main chain; meanwhile, a hydrophilic phenyl-containing monomer (octaphenyl POSS and octaphenyl cyclotetrasiloxane) with a space structure is introduced into the polymer structure, and the monomer has a three-dimensional space structure and rigid hydrophilic characteristics, so that the polymer structure has a larger free volume, and a smoother ion transmission channel is established, thereby improving the electrochemical performance of the membrane; the method has a good application prospect in the aspect of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis. The prepared anion exchange membrane has relatively high conductivity and alkali stability, and can be applied to equipment such as a water electrolyser.
Applicants: TIANJIN MAINLAND HYDROGEN EQUIPMENT CO LTD

Title: Six-arm star-shaped branched polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane, preparation method and application
Abstract: The invention discloses a six-arm star-shaped branched polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane, a preparation method and application, and belongs to the field of alkaline fuel cells and electrolyzed water. The preparation method comprises the following steps: introducing tri (4-carbazole-9-yl phenyl) amine with six branching sites into a polymer main chain as a branching unit, and carrying out Friedel-Crafts alkylation copolymerization on the branched unit, p-terphenyl and N-methyl-4-piperidone under the catalysis of superacid to prepare a six-arm star-shaped branched polymer main chain; and performing quaternization on a piperidine ring in the main chain through a Michaku reaction to obtain the target anion exchange membrane. According to the star-shaped branched structure disclosed by the invention, the free volume in the membrane is obviously increased, and a micro-phase separation structure with larger size and stronger connectivity is induced to be formed; the anion exchange membrane has high hydroxyl conductivity, excellent alkali stability, good mechanical performance and outstanding fuel cell and water electrolysis performance, and has wide application prospects in the field of electrochemical energy devices.

Title: Polyaryl-3-piperidone polymer, anion exchange membrane, and preparation method and application of polyaryl-3-piperidone polymer and anion exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention discloses a polyaryl-3-piperidone polymer, an anion exchange membrane and a preparation method and application of the polyaryl-3-piperidone polymer and the anion exchange membrane. A main chain of the polymer does not contain ether bonds and has cation 3-piperidine onium salt, so that the polymer has good alkali-resistant stability; through copolymerization with a hydrophobic unit, modification of a polymer is realized, a polymer with a hydrophilic/hydrophobic controllable structure is formed, and then the anion exchange membrane with excellent mechanical stability, ionic conductivity and alkali-resistant stability and relatively low swelling ratio is prepared. A membrane electrode further assembled by the prepared anion exchange membrane material can be used for alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production and alkaline fuel cells.

Title: Polyaryl methyl piperidine polymer, preparation method and anion exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production and fuel cells, particularly relates to preparation of a polyaryl methyl piperidine polymer and a high-stability anion exchange membrane prepared from the polyaryl methyl piperidine polymer, and further discloses a preparation method and application of the polyaryl methyl piperidine polymer. According to the polyaryl methyl piperidine polymer, a full-carbon-chain skeleton structure is adopted, a functional group, namely carbonyl, connected with an electron-rich benzene ring is migrated from a piperidine-containing ring to the fourth site or/and other sites of the piperidine ring, and polymerization of the aldehyde group and aromatic hydrocarbon is used for replacing traditional polymerization of ketone group and aromatic hydrocarbon, so that the polyaryl methyl piperidine polymer is obtained. The piperidine ring is suspended outside the aryl main chain in the polymer, the rigid structure of the piperidine ring is reserved, and the anion transmission rate and chemical stability are further improved. According to the polymer structure, modification of the polymer is realized by using strategies such as copolymerization with a hydrophobic unit, hyperbranched and the like, and the polymer with an ultrahigh stable chemical structure is formed.

Title: Main chain type polyaryl piperidine polymer as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to a main chain type polyaryl piperidine polymer as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving a linear structure phenyl monomer, a strong bond energy linear structure phenyl monomer, 1, 2-diphenylethane and N-methyl-4-piperidone to obtain a precursor polymer solution; dropwise adding trifluoroacetic acid and trifluoromethanesulfonic acid to obtain a main chain type polyarene piperidine polymer precursor; and dissolving the polyaromatic piperidine, adding methyl iodide and potassium carbonate, reacting to obtain a quaternized main chain type polyaromatic piperidine polymer, and carrying out membrane treatment and alkali treatment processes to obtain the anion exchange membrane. By introducing the high-rigidity hydrophobic linear monomer with strong bond energy, the problem of mutual entanglement between linear main chains of a traditional polymer is solved, larger free volume and steric hindrance are provided, and high ionic conductivity and high alkali stability of the anion exchange membrane are realized; therefore, the water electrolysis performance of the anion exchange membrane electrolytic tank is further improved, and high-performance and high-stability electrolytic tank application is realized.

Title: Self-crosslinking poly (aryl piperidine) anion exchange membrane material as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of high-performance anion exchange membranes for hydrogen production by electrolysis of water, and particularly discloses a self-crosslinking poly (aryl piperidine) anion exchange membrane material as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The poly (aryl piperidine) polymer is selected as a main chain without an ether bond, the cyclic piperidinium is selected as a cationic group, the chemical stability of the membrane material can be effectively improved, the free volume of the interior of the membrane material is increased by introducing a meta-terphenyl monomer with a bent conformation into a polymer structural unit, ion transmission is facilitated, and the membrane material has a good application prospect. And a self-crosslinking network is introduced to further promote the formation of an ionic conduction high-speed channel, and meanwhile, the excessive swelling of the membrane is limited, so that the ionic conductivity and mechanical stability of the membrane are improved. The prepared anion exchange membrane can be applied to hydrogen production through water electrolysis.

Title: Dibenzofuran-containing polyaryl suspended side chain type anionic polymer
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of macromolecules, and particularly discloses a dibenzofuran-containing polyaryl suspended side chain type anionic polymer, which successfully overcomes the defect that a main chain of a traditional polyarylether material is easy to break and degrade under a strong alkali condition by introducing a dibenzofuran structure, improves the chemical stability and the thermal stability of the material, and has a good application prospect. A benzene ring, quaternary ammonium or piperidine cation group is introduced by utilizing a side chain suspension strategy, microphase separation in the polymer is effectively promoted, and an efficient ion transmission channel can be constructed, so that the membrane material has good hydroxyl ion conductivity which can be up to 170.2 mS/cm at the temperature of 80 DEG C while a relatively low swelling rate is maintained, and the membrane material can be widely applied to the field of membrane materials. The polymer shows excellent mechanical properties, the tensile strength of a dry film is excellent, the alkali-resistant durability is excellent, and the conductivity loss is small when the polymer is soaked in a strong alkali (KOH) solution at 80 DEG C for more than 1800 hours. The anion exchange membrane prepared by the invention has good application value in the fields of fuel cells, water electrolysis hydrogen production and the like, and shows strong commercial potential.

Title: Polyaryl-piperidine polymer electrolyte membrane, preparation method and application
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of high-molecular polymer membrane materials, and discloses a polyaryl-piperidine polymer electrolyte membrane, and a preparation method and application thereof. The raw materials comprise an aryl monomer and 1-benzyl-4-piperidinecarboxaldehyde, or the aryl monomer, the 1-benzyl-4-piperidinecarboxaldehyde and a branching agent. A benzyl-containing piperidinium molecular framework is designed, a piperidine ring is connected with a main chain through a flexible spacer, meanwhile, benzyl is connected to an N atom, and the benzyl has large steric hindrance, so that the stability of AEM under an alkaline condition, especially under a high-temperature and high-concentration severe condition, is effectively relieved. Branching agents such as triphenylbenzene are added into a main chain structure to enhance the mechanical property and alkali-resistant stability of the main chain structure, and the polymer electrolyte membrane with high conductivity, high mechanical property and high alkali resistance is prepared by adopting a simple solution casting method and is applied to AEMWE.

Title: Enhanced anion exchange membrane for hydrogen production through water electrolysis and preparation method of enhanced anion exchange membrane
Abstract: The invention discloses an enhanced anion-exchange membrane for hydrogen production through water electrolysis and a preparation method of the enhanced anion-exchange membrane. The enhanced anion exchange membrane is composed of polymer resin A (side chain functionalized poly (p-terphenyl piperidine) polymer) and a base material modified by a semi-interpenetrating polymer (SIPN). The polymer resin takes alkali-resistant polyterphenyl piperidine as a main chain and is laterally grafted with a quaternary ammonium cation alkyl side chain containing a hydrophilic group, transmission sites of OH <-> are increased under the condition that the functionalization degree of the main chain is certain, and a microphase separation form is effectively constructed through interaction of the hydrophobic polymer main chain and the hydrophilic functionalized alkyl side chain, so that the polymer resin is prepared. The ionic conductivity of the membrane is greatly improved. According to a semi-interpenetrating network structure formed based on SIPN, high-molecular resin and a base material are tightly combined, and the problem that a composite membrane in the market is too high in gas permeability is solved.

Title: High-molecular-weight hyperbranched polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention provides a high-molecular-weight hyperbranched polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of membrane materials. The high-molecular-weight hyperbranched polyaryl piperidine anion exchange membrane provided by the invention is obtained by carrying out self-polymerization on a branched monomer or carrying out copolymerization on the branched monomer, a biphenyl monomer and N-methyl-4-piperidone and then carrying out quaternization conversion. The free volume of the anion exchange membrane is larger than that of a linear polymer, so that the anion exchange membrane shows ultrahigh conductivity; due to a high-molecular-weight polymer main chain (Mn is greater than 100K), the polymer has excellent alkali-resistant stability and mechanical strength; meanwhile, the anion exchange membrane has low water absorption swelling rate and dimensional stability, is suitable for hydrogen production by electrolysis of water and alkaline fuel cells, and has wide application prospects.

Title: Ferronickel-based oxygen evolution electrode and preparation method thereof based on interface confinement
Abstract: The invention provides a ferronickel-based oxygen evolution electrode and a preparation method thereof based on interface confinement. The preparation method of the ferronickel-based oxygen evolution electrode comprises the following steps: preparing a precursor solution containing ferrous ions and ferric ions; the foamed nickel substrate is cleaned; the cleaned foamed nickel is tightly attached to the surface of the bottom of the reaction container, the foamed nickel is immersed in the precursor solution, under the room-temperature standing condition, divalent and trivalent iron ions are induced to be subjected to a synergistic hydrolysis and coprecipitation reaction through a physical interface confinement space formed by an attached interface, and the nickel-based composite material is obtained. Therefore, a high-activity and high-uniformity nickel-iron-based (oxygen) hydroxide catalyst layer (DIC-NiFeOOH/NF) is grown on the surface of the foamed nickel in situ. The method is simple in process, green and energy-saving, and the prepared nickel-iron-based oxygen evolution electrode shows excellent performance in oxygen evolution reaction and anion exchange membrane water electrolysis.
Applicants: SUQIAN LYUNENG HYDROGEN TECH CO LTD

Title: Nickel-iron-cobalt-based self-supporting oxygen evolution electrode and preparation and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a nickel-iron-cobalt-based self-supporting oxygen evolution electrode and preparation and application thereof. A cleaned substrate nickel felt is soaked in a metal salt solution, taken out, subjected to vacuum drying and then reduced in a hydrogen atmosphere, and the self-supporting electrode can be prepared. The formed catalyst particles are in a nickel-iron-cobalt alloy state and grow in dense pores of the nickel fibers, and the unique self-supporting structure is beneficial to proceeding of the mass transfer process, reduction of charge transfer resistance and improvement of electrode stability. When the electrode is used for an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell, the current density is as high as 2.3 A cm <-2 > under the cell pressure of 2.0 V. During a durability test, the electrode maintains stability for more than 1400 hours at a current density of 1 A cm <-2 >. The preparation process does not need to use a binder, the production cost is reduced, and the catalyst is expected to be applied to the actual water electrolysis hydrogen production process due to excellent catalytic performance and durability.
Applicants: SHANGHAI QINGLUAN TECH CO LTD;;UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

Title: Self-supporting oxygen evolution electrode and preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a self-supporting oxygen evolution electrode and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production. The electrode is obtained by combining a hydrothermal method and an electro-deposition method; according to the electrode, a manganese-doped basic cobalt carbonate nanowire vertically grows on the surface of foamed nickel, and the periphery of the nanowire is wrapped with a plurality of lamellar nickel-iron double-metal hydroxide nanosheets to form a whole nanorod. The nanorods are uniform in size, the length of the nanorods is 2-3 microns, the diameter of the nanorods is 100-500 nm, and the nanorods vertically grow on the surface of the foamed nickel; the electrode has relatively high catalytic activity and stability, and after foamed nickel is used as a conductive substrate, the electrode can still stably run for a long time in a strong alkaline medium under relatively high electrolytic current; the electrode is applied to water electrolysis hydrogen production and oxygen evolution reaction under the catalytic alkaline condition. The invention can be applied to renewable fuel cells, photoelectrocatalysis, alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water (AEMWE) and electrolytic hydrogen generator devices.

Title: High-stability integrated oxygen evolution catalyst for anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell as well as preparation method and application of high-stability integrated oxygen evolution catalyst
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of electrocatalysts, in particular to a high-stability integrated oxygen evolution catalyst for an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell and a preparation method and application of the high-stability integrated oxygen evolution catalyst. The problems that in an existing anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell, the OER overpotential is high, a catalyst layer is prone to falling off under the ampere-level current density, the preparation method is complex, and large-scale preparation is difficult are solved. The method comprises the following steps: 1) adding ferric nitrate into isopropanol, and violently stirring and dissolving to obtain a solution A; thiourea is added into deionized water to be dissolved, and a solution B is obtained; adding the solution B into the solution A under violent stirring to obtain a uniform solution C; and 2) putting the metal porous material substrate subjected to ultrasonic cleaning with ethanol and a hydrochloric acid solution into the solution C for dipping, then taking out the metal porous material substrate, washing the metal porous material substrate with a large amount of deionized water, and drying the metal porous material substrate to obtain the integrated oxygen evolution catalyst. The prepared oxygen evolution catalyst not only has high oxygen evolution catalytic activity, but also is tightly combined with a substrate, and long-term stable operation with ampere-level current density can be realized.

Title: High-performance nickel-iron double-metal hydroxide catalytic electrode, preparation method and application
Abstract: The invention discloses a high-performance nickel-iron double-metal hydroxide catalytic electrode, a preparation method and application, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: step 1, uniformly mixing a certain amount of nickel salt solution and a certain amount of iron salt solution respectively, and then putting an activated nickel-containing substrate material into the mixed solution; and 2, depositing at room temperature for a certain time to obtain the catalytic electrode with a ferro-nickel double-metal hydroxide oxygen evolution catalyst growing on the surface. The invention designs a synthesis method for normal-temperature in-situ growth of a nickel-iron double-metal hydroxide (NiFe-LDH) oxygen evolution catalyst on a nickel-containing substrate material, low-cost batch green synthesis with nearly 100% of raw material utilization rate, zero waste liquid and no size limitation is realized, and the obtained catalytic electrode has excellent oxygen evolution catalytic performance and long-time stability; the method can be directly applied to alkaline (ALK) electrolytic baths and anion exchange membrane (AEM) electrolytic baths, the cost of the ALK electrolytic baths and the AEM electrolytic baths is remarkably reduced, and the method has important industrial application value.
Applicants: MAT INST CHINA ACADEMY ENG PHYSICS

Title: Cobalt-iron composite oxide oxygen evolution catalyst and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a ferrocobalt composite oxide oxygen evolution catalyst and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production catalysis. The preparation method of the cobalt-iron composite oxide oxygen evolution catalyst comprises the following steps: mixing cobalt oxide and iron oxide, carrying out dispersion treatment by using isopropanol after first grinding, and then carrying out ball milling, cooling, washing and drying to obtain a precursor; and mixing the precursor and lithium chloride, performing secondary grinding, and sintering to obtain the ferrocobalt composite oxide oxygen evolution catalyst. The cobalt-iron composite oxide oxygen evolution catalyst provided by the invention has the advantages of high activity, high stability, long service life and low cost, can be used as an oxygen evolution catalyst of systems such as alkaline electrolyzed water and anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water, has excellent catalytic performance, and can greatly reduce the energy consumption of water electrolysis hydrogen production.
Applicants: CSSC HANDAN PERIC HYDROGEN ENERGY TECH CO LTD

Title: Hollow array oxygen evolution electrode and preparation method and application thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a self-supporting nickel-iron double-metal hydroxide nanosheet coated cuprous sulfide hollow array oxygen evolution electrode, and belongs to the field of alkaline electrolyzed water. A self-supporting nickel-iron double-metal hydroxide nanosheet coated cuprous sulfide hollow array oxygen evolution electrode is obtained through a hydrothermal method in an alkaline medium; foamy copper is used as a substrate, the electrode structure comprises an outer layer consisting of a plurality of layered nickel-iron double-metal hydroxide nanosheets and an inner layer consisting of cuprous sulfide hollow nanorods, and the final morphology characteristics are as follows: the average diameter of each nanorod is 100-500nm, and the length of each nanorod is 2-3mu m; the electrode can effectively control the morphology of a synthetic catalyst under mild conditions, and has good catalytic activity and stability. The electrode is applied to the oxygen evolution reaction in the water electrolysis hydrogen production process under the catalytic alkaline condition. The invention can be applied to renewable fuel cells, photoelectrocatalysis, alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water and electrolytic hydrogen generator devices.

Title: Preparation method and application of self-supporting nickel-based double-metal hydroxide oxygen evolution electrode
Abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a self-supporting nickel-based double-metal hydroxide oxygen evolution electrode, and belongs to the field of water electrolysis hydrogen production. According to the method, the nickel-based double-metal hydroxide oxygen evolution electrode directly and vertically grown on a nickel fiber felt substrate is obtained through a simple one-step impregnation method. The electrode prepared by the method is applied to the water electrolysis oxygen evolution reaction under the catalytic alkaline condition. Wherein the obtained nickel-based double-metal hydroxide is in a nanoflower shape extending outwards from the center, the particle diameter of the nanoflower is 500 nm to 5 [mu] m, and the thickness of the nickel-based double-metal hydroxide is 5 to 10 [mu] m; the thickness of the nickel fiber felt ranges from 0.25 mm to 0.4 mm. As a three-dimensional skeleton of foamed nickel easily punctures an anionic membrane, the performance and long-term operation life of alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water (AEMWE) are influenced. Therefore, the nickel fiber felt is adopted as the substrate, and the problems can be effectively solved. In addition, the invention has wide utilization value in renewable fuel cells, photoelectrocatalysis, alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolyzed water and electrolytic hydrogen generator devices.

Title: Nickel iron molybdate oxygen evolution catalytic electrode and preparation method thereof
Abstract: The invention discloses a nickel iron molybdate oxygen evolution catalytic electrode and a preparation method thereof.The preparation method comprises the following steps that the surface of a foamed nickel sheet is cleaned and dried, and a clean oil-free foamed nickel sheet is obtained; dissolving nickel nitrate, ferric nitrate and ammonium heptamolybdate in deionized water to obtain dispersion liquid; transferring the dispersion liquid into a hydrothermal kettle, putting a foamed nickel sheet into the hydrothermal kettle, carrying out hydrothermal treatment in a drying oven, naturally cooling, washing and drying to obtain foamed nickel loaded with nickel molybdate and iron molybdate catalysts; and preparing an ionomer solution, spraying the ionomer solution onto the electrode precursor, and drying to obtain the oxygen evolution catalytic electrode. The invention provides a preparation scheme of the anion exchange membrane water electrolysis oxygen evolution catalytic electrode which is simple in preparation method, low in synthesis cost, non-toxic and harmless, and the catalyst in the electrode has a microstructure different from that of a common molybdate catalyst and has high electrochemical catalytic activity. The electrolytic bath based on the catalytic electrode can efficiently electrolyze dilute alkali liquor to produce hydrogen, and the energy consumption and the safety of the electrolytic bath are superior to those of a traditional alkaline water electrolysis system.

Title: Composite bifunctional catalyst based on perovskite as well as preparation method and application of composite bifunctional catalyst
Abstract: The invention provides a perovskite composite difunctional (oxygen evolution and hydrogen evolution) catalyst with rich active sites. The perovskite composite difunctional (oxygen evolution and hydrogen evolution) catalyst is composed of a main phase perovskite oxide substrate with electrochemical activity and a nanosheet proton conductor beta-NaFeO2 with excellent proton affinity. A two-step self-assembly strategy is adopted for preparation of the composite catalyst, and formation of a high-energy interface between two phases is ensured, so that an electronic structure between a perovskite substrate and a proton conductor is effectively adjusted, and multiple active sites beneficial to oxygen evolution and hydrogen evolution reaction are induced. On one hand, the formed two-phase high-energy interface is helpful for exciting lattice oxygen on the surface of the catalyst to participate in oxygen evolution reaction, so that the lattice oxygen is induced to participate in an oxygen evolution reaction mechanism; the deprotonation rate of an oxygen evolution reaction and the water splitting rate of a hydrogen evolution reaction are accelerated through the cooperation of the composite material and a proton conductor, so that the oxygen evolution and hydrogen evolution performance of the composite material is greatly improved, and the composite material has a good application prospect in the field of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production.

Title: Combined anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production system
Abstract: The invention provides a combined anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production system which comprises a direct-current power supply, an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell, a hydrogen side heat exchanger, an oxygen side heat exchanger, a gas-liquid separation device, a hydrogen washer, an oxygen washer, a hydrogen side pneumatic valve and an oxygen side pneumatic valve. After being subjected to gas-liquid separation by the gas-liquid separation device, hydrogen and oxygen respectively enter the hydrogen scrubber and the oxygen scrubber, are cooled and washed by the hydrogen scrubber and the oxygen scrubber to reduce the alkali content and the water content in the hydrogen and the oxygen, and are output to the hydrogen side pneumatic valve and the oxygen side pneumatic valve to be emptied or purified; the direct-current power supply and the anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell form a water electrolysis hydrogen production module, and a plurality of water electrolysis hydrogen production modules are connected in parallel to form the water electrolysis hydrogen production system. According to the technical scheme, the electrolysis area of a single electrolytic cell of the water electrolysis hydrogen production system can be reduced, the gas production rate of water electrolysis hydrogen production equipment is increased, and the equipment investment cost is further reduced.
Applicants: CSSC HANDAN PERIC HYDROGEN ENERGY TECH CO LTD

Title: Plateau-oriented anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen and oxygen production system and method
Abstract: The invention relates to the field of hydrogen and oxygen production through water electrolysis, and discloses a plateau-oriented anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen and oxygen production system and method.The plateau-oriented anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen and oxygen production system comprises a liquid supply unit, an electrolytic bath unit, a gas-liquid separation and purification unit, a pressure control unit and a central control and coordination unit; the electrolytic cell unit is connected with the gas-liquid separation and purification unit, condensate water generated by the gas-liquid separation and purification unit flows back to the liquid supply unit, the pressure balance control unit is respectively connected with a hydrogen side and an oxygen side in the gas-liquid separation and purification unit, and the central control and coordination unit is connected with the electrolytic cell unit. The system can solve the technical problems of how to realize long-term high efficiency of the anion exchange membrane water electrolysis system in a plateau low-pressure environment, guarantee hydrogen safety and stably supply oxygen. And in addition, the system reliability and the environmental adaptability are remarkably improved, and the technical effect of double requirements of hydrogen and oxygen co-production in special scenes is met.

Title: Differential pressure type anion exchange membrane water electrolysis automation system and hydrogen production method
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and discloses a differential pressure type anion exchange membrane water electrolysis automation system and a hydrogen production method. The system comprises an electrolytic bath, a water replenishing unit, a condensing unit, a collecting unit and a controller, and oxygen generated by the electrolytic bath is discharged out after passing through a raw material water tank and an oxygen-water separator in the water replenishing unit under normal pressure; hydrogen generated by the electrolytic cell is subjected to secondary treatment through a hydrogen separator and a hydrogen-water separator in the collecting unit, then is pressurized by a back pressure valve in the collecting unit and then is output, and a differential pressure type system on the two sides of hydrogen and oxygen is formed; the raw material water tank in the water replenishing unit can realize automatic feeding, and the starting and stopping of the circulating pump and the electrolytic bath in the water replenishing unit are controlled by the liquid level in the raw material water tank, so that the full-automatic feeding, circulating and electrolysis control is realized, the intelligent degree of hydrogen production by water electrolysis is greatly improved, the risk of manual regulation and control is reduced, and meanwhile, the miniaturization effect of hydrogen production equipment is achieved.
Applicants: BEIJING ZHONGGUEFENG INDUSTRY TECH DEVELOPMENT LIMITED COMPANY

Title: Differential pressure type anion exchange membrane water electrolysis automation system
Abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and discloses a differential pressure type anion exchange membrane water electrolysis automation system. The system comprises an electrolytic bath, a water replenishing unit, a condensing unit, a collecting unit and a controller, and oxygen generated by the electrolytic bath is discharged out after passing through a raw material water tank and an oxygen-water separator in the water replenishing unit under normal pressure; hydrogen generated by the electrolytic cell is subjected to secondary treatment through a hydrogen separator and a hydrogen-water separator in the collecting unit, then is pressurized by a back pressure valve in the collecting unit and then is output, and a differential pressure type system on the two sides of hydrogen and oxygen is formed; the raw material water tank in the water replenishing unit can realize automatic feeding, and the starting and stopping of the circulating pump and the electrolytic bath in the water replenishing unit are controlled by the liquid level in the raw material water tank, so that the full-automatic feeding, circulating and electrolysis control is realized, the intelligent degree of hydrogen production by water electrolysis is greatly improved, the risk of manual regulation and control is reduced, and meanwhile, the miniaturization effect of hydrogen production equipment is achieved.

Title: Testing device and testing method for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production membrane electrode
Abstract: The invention relates to the field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and provides a testing device and a testing method of an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production membrane electrode, and the testing device comprises an electrolytic tank unit which comprises a cathode area and an anode area and is used for electrolyzing electrolyte; the gas-liquid separation unit comprises a cathode gas-liquid separation unit and an anode gas-liquid separation unit, the cathode gas-liquid separation unit is communicated with the cathode region of the electrolytic tank, and the anode gas-liquid separation unit is communicated with the anode region of the electrolytic tank; the collection unit is communicated with a gas outlet of the gas-liquid separation unit and is used for collecting the gas generated by the electrolytic tank unit; the electrolyte unit is used for providing electrolyte with various concentrations and/or pH values for the electrolytic tank unit; and the computer control system is in communication connection with the electrolytic tank unit, the gas-liquid separation unit, the electrolyte unit, the collection unit and the power supply. The device has the advantages of intelligent regulation and control of the electrolyte concentration and pH value for testing, real-time monitoring and regulation and control, high testing efficiency, good accuracy, strong stability and strong adaptability.
Applicants: HONGJI CHUANGNENG TECH GUANGZHOU CO LTD

Title: Testing device for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production membrane electrode
Abstract: The utility model relates to the field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and provides a testing device of a membrane electrode for water electrolysis hydrogen production of an anion exchange membrane, which comprises an electrolytic tank unit comprising a cathode area and an anode area and used for electrolyzing electrolyte; the gas-liquid separation unit comprises a cathode gas-liquid separation unit and an anode gas-liquid separation unit, the cathode gas-liquid separation unit is communicated with the cathode region of the electrolytic tank, and the anode gas-liquid separation unit is communicated with the anode region of the electrolytic tank; the electrolyte unit is used for providing electrolyte with various concentrations and/or pH values for the electrolytic tank unit; and the computer control system is in communication connection with the electrolytic tank unit, the gas-liquid separation unit and the electrolyte unit. The device has the advantages of intelligent regulation and control of the electrolyte concentration and pH value for testing, real-time monitoring and regulation and control, high testing efficiency, good accuracy, strong stability and strong adaptability.
Applicants: HONGJI CHUANGNENG TECH GUANGZHOU CO LTD

Title: Anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production test system and test method thereof
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production testing, in particular to an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production testing system and a testing method thereof. The invention discloses an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production test system. The hydrogen side gas-liquid separation device is arranged at one end of the electrolysis device and is communicated with the electrolytic cell, and a gas-liquid separation device is arranged in the hydrogen side gas-liquid separation device and is used for carrying out gas-liquid separation on hydrogen which is formed by electrolysis in the electrolytic cell and contains alkali liquor steam; and the oxygen alkali washing device is arranged at the other end of the electrolysis device, and the oxygen alkali washing device is communicated with the electrolysis tank so as to carry out alkali washing treatment on oxygen which is formed by electrolysis in the electrolysis tank and contains alkali liquor steam. A two-way alkali liquor recovery mechanism is adopted, the gas-liquid separation device is arranged on the hydrogen side, the alkali washing device is arranged on the oxygen side, and the problem that alkali liquor on the hydrogen side is lost due to traditional single-side alkali washing is solved.
Applicants: CHANGZHOU QINGZHOU ENERGY TECH CO LTD

Title: Mixed water electrolysis hydrogen production system and method with multiple types of electrolytic cells cooperatively operated
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of hydrogen production, in particular to a mixed water electrolysis hydrogen production system and method with multiple types of electrolytic cells cooperatively operated. The mixed electrolysis unit is composed of an alkaline electrolytic cell array and an anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell array, and the two arrays are connected into a hydrogen purification system in parallel through a multi-channel gas-liquid separator; the intelligent power supply module is electrically connected with the electrolysis unit, has a dynamic voltage regulation function, outputs a voltage range of 20-100V, and is integrated with a harmonic suppression circuit; the multi-dimensional sensing network comprises a distributed temperature sensor array embedded in an electrolytic bath pole plate, a multi-phase pressure detection unit of an electrolyte circulating pipeline and a laser gas analyzer of a hydrogen production pipeline; according to the scheme, the novel hydrogen production system capable of achieving efficient cooperation of multiple types of electrolytic cells and dynamically optimizing current distribution is provided, and the technical problem that wide-range load adaptability and operation energy efficiency are difficult to achieve at the same time is fundamentally solved.
Applicants: BEIJING YINENG HYDROGEN SOURCE TECH CO LTD

Title: Water electrolysis hydrogen production purification system and hydrogen production equipment
Abstract: The invention relates to a water electrolysis hydrogen production purification system and hydrogen production equipment. The system comprises an anion exchange membrane electrolytic tank unit and a hydrogen purification unit, the anion exchange membrane electrolytic tank unit is used for electrolyzing deionized water to generate hydrogen; the hydrogen purification unit is connected with a cathode outlet of the anion exchange membrane electrolytic tank unit and is used for deeply purifying the hydrogen; wherein the anion exchange membrane electrolytic tank unit comprises a membrane electrode and a cathode diffusion layer; the cathode side of the membrane electrode is in close contact with the cathode diffusion layer; and the cathode diffusion layer has an asymmetric gradient aperture and hydrogen selective separation function and is used for performing in-situ selective separation and primary purification on the hydrogen. The integration level of the hydrogen production purification system can be improved, and the operation and maintenance cost can be reduced.
Applicants: GUANGDONG NEW ENERGY STORAGE NATIONAL RESEARCH INST CO LTD

Title: Method and system for in-situ monitoring, regulation and control of thermal field of anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production device
Abstract: The invention discloses an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis hydrogen production device thermal field in-situ monitoring and regulation method and system, and belongs to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, and the system comprises an electrolytic bath, a temperature detection unit, a data acquisition and temperature control unit, a temperature regulation unit and an electrolyte supply unit. According to the invention, the temperature sensor is embedded between the gas-liquid diffusion layer of the cathode of the membrane electrode and the bipolar plate, so that in-situ detection of the real working temperature of the membrane electrode in the electrolysis process is realized, and errors caused by the traditional characterization by electrolyte temperature are avoided. The temperature obtained through in-situ measurement serves as a feedback variable, a thermal field closed-loop regulation and control system is constructed, dynamic control over the membrane electrode temperature is achieved by adjusting the electrolyte heat supply state, the membrane electrode temperature is stabilized in the optimal operation interval, and therefore the operation cost and the device stability are both considered. The method is suitable for a water electrolysis hydrogen production system under the condition of pure water electrolyte, and has a good engineering application prospect.

Title: METHOD FOR MANUFACTURING ANION EXCHANGE MEMBRANE WATER ELECTROLYSIS SYSTEM
Abstract: Provided is a method of manufacturing an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis system exhibiting improved durability and efficiency, along with excellent water electrolysis performance.
Applicants: HANWHA SOLUTIONS CORP;;KOREA ADVANCED INST SCI & TECH;;YONSEI UNIV UNIV INDUSTRY FOUNDATION UIF

Title: OXIDATION CATALYST HAVING PEROVSKITE STRUCTURE FOR ANION EXCHANGE MEMBRANE WATER ELECTROLYSIS AND PREPARATION METHOD USING CO-PRECIPITATION REACTION THEREFOR
Abstract: Provided are an oxidation catalyst for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis exhibiting excellent catalytic activity and electrical conductivity, a uniform particle size distribution and a large surface area, and excellent durability, and a preparation method thereof, an anode for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis and an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis system, each including the oxidation catalyst.

Title: Catalyst and porous transport electrode for water electrolysis of anion exchange membrane preparation method thereof and use thereof
Abstract: The present invention relates to a catalyst for a negative ion exchange membrane water electrolysis, an electrode comprising the same, a manufacturing method thereof, and uses thereof, wherein the catalyst for the negative ion exchange membrane water electrolysis exhibits a high activity as high as that of a noble metal catalyst by using an inexpensive transition metal, has the advantages of excellent electrical conductivity, including phosphide, and excellent thermal stability, and can optimize water electrolysis cell performance by controlling the porosity of the nickel foam.

Title: High-durability anion exchange membrane water electrolysis catalyst layer manufacturing method thereof and water electrolysis electrode and water electrolysis device including the same
Abstract: The present invention relates to a highly durable anion exchange membrane water electrolysis catalyst layer, a manufacturing method thereof, and a water electrolysis electrode and a water electrolysis device comprising the same, and more specifically, to a water electrolysis catalyst layer, a manufacturing method thereof, a water electrolysis electrode and a water electrolysis device comprising the same, wherein the water electrolysis catalyst layer coated with polydopamine is provided to prevent the separation of a hydrogen catalyst layer, and the durability and energy conversion efficiency of the water electrolysis device are increased through strong adhesive force with a mass transfer layer.

Title: ELECTRODE CATALYST FOR WATER ELECTROLYSIS CELL, WATER ELECTROLYSIS CELL AND WATER ELECTROLYZER
Abstract: An electrode catalyst for a water electrolysis cell includes a catalyst, and a polymer of intrinsic microporosity having a Tröger's base skeleton containing a quaternary ammonium group. A water electrolysis cell includes an anode, a cathode, and an electrolyte membrane. The electrolyte membrane is disposed between the anode and the cathode. At least one selected from the group consisting of the anode and the cathode includes the electrode catalyst.

Title: NANO FLAKE-SHAPED SPINEL OXIDATION CATALYST FOR ANION EXCHANGE MEMBRANE WATER ELECTROLYSIS AND PREPARATION METHOD THEREOF
Abstract: The present invention relates to an oxidation catalyst for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis that exhibits excellent catalytic activity, electrical conductivity and a large surface area, and a preparation method thereof, an anode for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis and an anion exchange membrane water electrolysis system, each including the same.The oxidation catalyst for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis of the present invention includes a spinel-based oxide, and is prepared by precisely controlling the use of complexing agent and the pH using a co-precipitation method, whereby the oxidation catalyst can reduce the catalyst particle size to facilitate uniform dispersion of high viscosity and has a nano-sized flake structure, which makes it possible to uniformly coat the ionomer between flakes, and forms a porous structure, thereby widening the surface area and achieving excellent catalytic activity.

Title: ELECTROLYTE MEMBRANE AND WATER ELECTROLYSIS DEVICE USING THE SAME
Abstract: To provide an electrolyte membrane having excellent solubility, that is, good film-forming properties and excellent alkali durability and the electrolyte membrane is particularly suitable for anion exchange-membrane water electrolysis and can generate hydrogen efficiently.SOLUTION: There is provided an electrolyte membrane using a polymer whose molecular weight distribution index (Mw/Mn) satisfies the following expression (equation 1).SELECTED DRAWING: None

Title: METHOD FOR PRODUCING WATER ELECTROLYSIS CATALYST COMPRISING TRANSITION METAL CHALCOGENIDE
Abstract: The present invention discloses a catalyst electrode for water electrolysis, comprising: a metal foam; and a composite transition metal chalcogenide heterostructure formed on the metal foam. The catalyst electrode for water electrolysis can exhibit improved electrochemical catalytic activity in both hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) and oxygen evolution reaction (OER) in water electrolysis reaction, can efficiently produce hydrogen with lower energy supply than existing noble metal electrodes, and can be used in both anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer and solar cell-water electrolysis system.

Title: ELECTROLYTE MEMBRANE AND WATER ELECTROLYSIS DEVICE USING THE SAME
Abstract: To provide an electrolyte membrane having excellent solubility, that is, good film-forming properties and excellent alkali durability and the electrolyte membrane is particularly suitable for an anion exchange-membrane water electrolysis and can generate hydrogen efficiently.SOLUTION: There is provided an electrolyte membrane using a polymer which satisfies the following expression (equation 1) for Mw (weight-average molecular weight).SELECTED DRAWING: None

Title: CHIRAL METAL OXIDE-BASED ANION EXCHANGE MEMBRANE WATER ELECTROLYSIS DEVICE AND MANUFACTURING METHOD THEREFOR
Abstract: Provided are a chiral metal oxide-based anion exchange membrane water electrolysis device and a manufacturing method therefor. The chiral metal oxide-based anion exchange membrane water electrolysis device includes an L-type or D-type chiral metal oxide, which may possess chirality-induced spin selectivity, and thus, when used in a water electrolysis device including same, spin polarization may be controlled without an additional external magnetic field, and the efficiency of an electrode and the device may be improved.

Title: AEM electrolytic bath
Abstract: The invention provides an AEM electrolytic bath which comprises a cathode end plate, a cathode insulating layer, an electrolysis unit, an anode insulating layer and an anode end plate which are sequentially arranged in the same direction. Each small electrolysis chamber comprises a cathode plate, a cathode sealing ring, a cathode gas diffusion layer, an anion exchange membrane, an anode gas diffusion layer and an anode plate which are sequentially arranged in the same direction, the cathode plate and the anode plate at the series connection part between the small electrolysis chambers are combined to form a bipolar plate, the cathode plate comprises a cathode surface, and the anode plate comprises an anode surface; the bipolar plate comprises a cathode surface and an anode surface; a concave area and an outer frame area are arranged on the cathode surface and the anode surface, the outer frame area is arranged around the concave area, a plurality of raised lines are arranged in the concave area, a diversion trench is formed between the raised lines, confluence trenches are arranged in the concave area at two ends of the diversion trench, and the confluence trenches are communicated with the diversion trench. According to the scheme, the uniform diffusion of the electrolyte in the AEM electrolytic cell is realized.
Applicants: SUZHOU JUNA NEW MATERIAL TECH CO LTD;;SHANGHAI JUNA NEW MATERIAL TECH CO LTD

Title: AEM electrolytic bath
Abstract: The invention provides an AEM electrolytic bath which comprises a cathode end plate, a cathode insulating layer, an electrolysis unit, an anode insulating layer and an anode end plate which are sequentially arranged in the same direction, and the electrolysis unit comprises small electrolysis chambers arranged in series; from the cathode insulating layer to the anode insulating layer, each small electrolysis chamber comprises a cathode plate, a cathode sealing ring, a cathode gas diffusion layer, an anion exchange membrane, an anode gas diffusion layer, an anode sealing ring and an anode plate which are sequentially arranged, and the cathode plate and the anode plate at the series connection part between the small electrolysis chambers are combined to form a bipolar plate; the cathode plate comprises a cathode surface, the anode plate comprises an anode surface, the bipolar plate comprises a cathode surface and an anode surface, the cathode surface and the anode surface are provided with a concave area and an outer frame area, the outer frame area surrounds the concave area, the concave area is respectively provided with two confluence runners, and a branch runner is arranged between the two confluence runners; and the two ends of the branch flow channel are communicated with the confluence flow channel. According to the scheme, uniform diffusion of the electrolyte is realized.
Applicants: SHANGHAI JUNA NEW MATERIAL TECH CO LTD

Title: AEM electrolytic bath
Abstract: The invention provides an AEM electrolytic cell which comprises a cathode end plate, a cathode insulating layer, an electrolytic cell, an anode insulating layer and an anode end plate which are sequentially arranged, the electrolytic cell is provided with a first ventilation channel, a second ventilation channel, a first liquid passing channel and a second liquid passing channel, and the cross section of each channel is triangular; in the direction from the cathode end plate to the anode end plate, each small electrolysis chamber comprises a cathode plate, a cathode sealing ring, a cathode gas diffusion layer, an anion exchange membrane, an anode gas diffusion layer and an anode plate which are sequentially arranged, each cathode plate comprises a cathode surface, each anode plate comprises an anode surface, and the cathode plates and the anode plates at the series connection parts between the small electrolysis chambers form a bipolar plate; a cathode reaction cavity is formed between the cathode surface and the cathode gas diffusion layer, an anode reaction cavity is formed between the anode surface and the anode gas diffusion layer, the first ventilation channel and the first liquid channel are communicated with the cathode reaction cavity, and the second ventilation channel and the second liquid channel are communicated with the anode reaction cavity; and flow guide channels are arranged in the cathode reaction cavity and the anode reaction cavity.
Applicants: SHANGHAI JUNA NEW MATERIAL TECH CO LTD

Title: Alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell
Abstract: The invention discloses an alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell which comprises a cathode end plate, a cathode plate, a gasket, an anode plate and an anode end plate, and the cathode end plate, the cathode plate, the gasket, the anode plate and the anode end plate are fastened by screws through the peripheral screw holes. The alkaline anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell has the advantages of being simple in structure, convenient to assemble and fast in response, can well adapt to the volatility of renewable energy sources, is applied to the field of renewable energy source hydrogen production, and can improve the economical efficiency. The device can work under the alkaline or pure water condition, expensive precious metal does not need to be used as an electrode catalyst, and the cost of a hydrogen production system is greatly reduced.
Applicants: YANGTZE RIVER DELTA RES INSTITUTE UESTC HUZHOU

Title: Magnetic field assisted water electrolysis hydrogen production device
Abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of water electrolysis hydrogen production, in particular to a magnetic field assisted water electrolysis hydrogen production device which comprises an anode plate and a cathode plate, spiral flow channels are formed in the opposite faces of the anode plate and the cathode plate, the lower end of the anode plate is fixedly connected with a connecting plate, and the lower end of the cathode plate is fixedly connected with a transverse plate. The transverse plate is movably connected with the connecting plate; a limiting mechanism is separated from a limiting hole by pulling a pull ring, an anode plate and a cathode plate are separated, meanwhile, a liquid guide mechanism slides out, electrolyte left in a spiral flow channel is guided and discharged, the electrolyte is prevented from falling onto the surface of an electromagnetic coil, and an old catalyst and an anion exchange membrane are taken down, so that the service life of the catalyst is prolonged. And after a new catalyst and the anion exchange membrane are mounted on the anode plate, the anode plate is pushed to be in contact with the cathode plate, so that the limiting mechanism is clamped into the limiting hole again, and the operation is convenient and efficient.

Title: Anion exchange membrane electrolytic bath and hydrogen-oxygen generator
Abstract: The utility model provides an end plate, anion exchange membrane electrolyzer and oxyhydrogen generator, the end plate comprises: an end plate body, the end plate body is provided with a first overflow hole along its thickness direction, the end plate body is an insulator; the annular lining is arranged in the first overflowing hole in a sleeved mode. The end plate body is the plate-shaped insulator made of the insulating material, and the end plate body is insulated, so that an insulating plate positioned on one side of the end plate body in the electrolytic cell can be removed, the weight of the electrolytic cell can be reduced, the assembling efficiency of the electrolytic cell can be improved, and the production cost of the electrolytic cell can be reduced; the annular lining is an annular structural part made of corrosion-resistant materials, the annular lining is arranged in the first overflowing hole in a sleeved mode, electrolyte can enter the electrolytic bath through an inner hole of the annular lining, and therefore the end plate body can not make direct contact with the electrolyte, and the service life of the end plate body can be prolonged.
Applicants: HUIZHOU EVE HYDROGEN ENERGY CO LTD

Title: CELL STACK AND HYDROGEN PRODUCTION DEVICE
Abstract: A cell stack according to the present invention is to be provided to a hydrogen production device and comprises: a layered body that includes a plurality of electrolysis cells; a first end plate and a second end plate that are provided on respective sides of the layered body; and a fastening mechanism that fastens the first end plate and the second end plate toward each other. The fastening mechanism has an elastic member that presses the first end plate toward the second end plate. Each of the plurality of electrolysis cells has: an anode, anion exchange membrane, and cathode set; and separators that are provided on respective sides of the set. The separators have an electroconductive plate and a frame body that supports an outer peripheral edge part of the electroconductive plate. The frame body is made of resin.

Title: High-stability AEM water electrolysis hydrogen production electrolytic cell capable of rapidly desorbing bubbles
Abstract: The high-stability AEM water electrolysis hydrogen production electrolytic cell comprises a membrane electrode assembly, an electrode plate and an end plate, the membrane electrode assembly comprises an anion exchange membrane, a catalytic layer plate, a gas diffusion layer plate and a bipolar plate, a bidirectional snakelike flow channel is formed in the side, close to the electrode plate, of the bipolar plate, and the end plate is arranged in the bipolar plate. A gas diffusion layer plate is arranged on the bipolar plate, a catalyst layer plate is arranged on the gas diffusion layer plate, a radial flow channel is arranged on one side of the bipolar plate close to the gas diffusion layer plate, a low-density through hole and a high-density through hole are arranged on the gas diffusion layer plate, and a groove is arranged on the catalyst layer plate. Through a bipolar plate gradient flow field and a turbulent flow increasing effect, electrolyte distribution dynamic balance is realized, gas discharge is accelerated, bubbles are forcibly stripped by utilizing a fluid momentum difference, rapid desorption of the bubbles is ensured, and through combination of high and low density through holes and micron-sized honeycomb grooves, the bubbles are directionally migrated and desorbed, and the desorption speed of the bubbles is accelerated.

Title: Rack-based anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell capable of adjusting operating power
Abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrolytic cells, and particularly discloses a rack-based anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell capable of adjusting operation power, the rack-based anion exchange membrane electrolytic cell comprises a square current collecting end plate and a mounting plate which are arranged in parallel, a plurality of small electrolysis chambers are arranged between the current collecting end plate and the mounting plate in series, and current collecting blocks are arranged at the tops of polar plates of the small electrolysis chambers; the plurality of current collecting blocks are arranged in a row along the transverse direction; a rack stretching across the top of the electrolysis chamber is arranged at the tops of the current collecting end plate and the mounting plate through connecting lugs, a gear sliding block mechanism is arranged on the rack, and a sliding contact block connected with the current collecting end plate through a wire is arranged on the gear sliding block mechanism; the number of the small electrolysis chambers in the actual operation process is adjusted by changing the position of a gear sliding block mechanism on the upper portion of the electrolytic cell, then the hydrogen production rate and the consumed power of the electrolytic cell are adjusted, the fluctuation electric power of a power grid is adapted, and energy loss is reduced.
Applicants: SHAANXI QINGNENG POWER TECH CO LTD

Title: AEM membrane electrode, AEM electrolytic bath and electrolytic hydrogen production method
Abstract: The invention discloses an AEM membrane electrode, an AEM electrolytic bath and an electrolytic hydrogen production method, and belongs to the technical field of electrolytic hydrogen production. The AEM membrane electrode is of a vertical structure and comprises an anode current collection mass transfer catalytic layer, an anion exchange membrane, a cathode catalytic layer and a cathode current collection mass transfer layer from top to bottom, the AEM electrolytic tank comprises an anode end plate, a plurality of small electrolytic chambers and a cathode end plate from top to bottom; every two adjacent small electrolysis chambers are isolated through a positive and negative composite plate; the anode surface of the cathode-anode composite plate is communicated with the alkali liquor inlet and the alkali liquor outlet, and the cathode surface of the cathode-anode composite plate is communicated with the hydrogen outlet; the small electrolysis chamber comprises an AEM membrane electrode, an anode current collection mass transfer catalytic layer of the AEM membrane electrode is in contact with an anode surface of the cathode-anode composite plate, and a cathode current collection mass transfer catalytic layer of the AEM membrane electrode is in contact with a cathode surface of the cathode-anode composite plate. The membrane electrode has better operation stability and more efficient hydrogen production performance, the purity of gas produced by an electrolytic bath is high, the equipment safety is high, the water content of hydrogen is low, and the gas purification and drying cost is low.
Applicants: SHANDONG SAIKESAISI HYDROGEN ENERGY CO LTD
